request.user:
Subject: Physics
Question type: single-correct (exactly one option is right)

A resistance of 40 ohm and an inductance are connected in series in a 50 cycles/second ac circuit. The impedance of this combination is very nearly
(A) 30 ohm
(B) 40 ohm
(C) 50 ohm
(D) 60 ohm

result.working: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (2*pi*f*L)^2) with R = 40 ohm and f = 50 Hz. L is not given, so X_L and Z cannot be computed. Z must exceed 40 ohm, which rules out 30 ohm and 40 ohm. Choosing between 50 ohm and 60 ohm needs L.
result.note: The inductance value is missing from the question. The standard version of this problem uses L = 95.5 mH, which gives X_L = 30 ohm and Z = 50 ohm (option C). That value is not stated here, so I cannot confirm it from the given data.
